notes: The Python validator (validation/validators/rustre-deobf.py) is a pure-Python reference re-implementation of the rustre-deobf public API surface (Patch/Context/Pipeline/Pattern/Crypto helpers/Reports/CFG/DCE/Registry). Its __main__ only prints 4 deterministic reference scalars. The MCP wire surface for rustre-deobf* exposes a single tool: 'deobf_mba_normalize' (rustre-deobf-mba crate). There is NO MCP endpoint that wraps the high-level rustre-deobf pipeline/crypto/CFG primitives reproduced by this validator, so direct input/output equality cannot be tested for those primitives. We record both sides for transparency.
gap: MCP wire surface does not expose rustre-deobf pipeline/Patch/Context/Pattern/Crypto helpers (entropy, CRC32, Adler32, RC4, XOR brute-force, ChaCha20, CFG normalizer, DCE) covered by the Python validator. Only rustre-deobf-mba is wired. Consider adding MCP tools for: deobf_entropy_scan, deobf_pattern_scan, deobf_xor_recover, deobf_rc4_brute, deobf_cfg_normalize.
